A polish release: the queue, sign-in and Offline pages behave better, lists play from their menus, and a long list of fixes under the hood.

### Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `Ond-0.4.4-macos-universal.dmg` (or `.zip`) | macOS 11 or later, Apple silicon and Intel |
| `Ond-0.4.4-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Linux on x86_64, glibc 2.39 or newer (Ubuntu 24.04, Fedora 40, Debian 13) |
| `Ond-0.4.4-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | Linux on ARM64, same requirements |
| `Ond-0.4.4-windows-x86_64.zip` | Windows 10 and 11. Still untested on real hardware; issues welcome. |

On NixOS or with Nix: `nix profile install github:Solidsilver/ond/v0.4.4`. Install steps for every platform are in the [README](https://github.com/Solidsilver/ond#install).

### Browsing and playing

- An empty queue no longer lets the page spill under the queue column.
- Play is in the right-click menu of every list: album rows, artist rows, song rows and downloads. Double-click to play is gone from tiles and rows; a click opens, and the hover button or the menu plays.
- In Songs and Favorites the playing marker has a column of its own, so titles line up.
- Recently added shows its count. Albums and Artists hide the sort pill in list view, where the column headers sort.
- The output picker's link opens Settings › Output. A narrow window shows a volume glyph beside the device.
- The Info tab's playback line wraps between its parts instead of mid-phrase.
- The mini player has a new icon and its corner buttons are readable over any cover.

### Signing in and out

- Sign out asks first and says what happens: playback stops, the queue clears, the password is forgotten, downloads stay.
- Cancel while connecting. The form keeps what you typed, and the first empty field is focused.
- A server and username set from Home Manager show as values, not greyed fields.
- A server that doesn't allow Ond's way of signing in says so instead of "wrong password".
- A heart or rating that can't be saved reports the reason, and stays quiet while the server is known to be offline.

### Offline

- Offline mode is called that everywhere: Settings, the sidebar, the Offline page and the mini player.
- A download in progress is listed once, under In progress. Finished items show a check.
- "Nothing downloaded yet" instead of "0 bytes". The download folder is shortened in the middle, with the full path on hover. The note about a pending folder move shows only when one is pending.
- The store refuses to move into a folder inside itself, never pins an empty id, and leaves hidden files alone.

### Settings

- An esc hint on the window, which now stays below the toolbar in narrow windows.
- Sync now says why it's disabled. Shortcut labels say what each one does.

### Under the hood

- Audio: a seek superseded while the decoder finishes the previous one no longer leaves playback held; switching devices while a track is still loading plays it from where it was asked; the next track is prefetched while it downloads; a CoreAudio unit that fails to start is reopened; ALSA card paths are read in every form.
- The stream cache no longer keeps a web page that answered 200 as audio, and downloads a file again if it was deleted behind its back.
- An unreadable analysis database is set aside and a fresh one started.
- The search index is rebuilt only when an opened album changed; the queue lays out only the lines on screen; lists and tiles do less per row.
- Work from an account that signed out is dropped when another signs in. A queue group's id follows its first track, not its index.
- The settings file failing to write is reported once.
- The offline crate is split into download, persist and moving modules; the library exports only its current row types and pins their wire formats.
